title: M13 — Break/fix 03: Metrics — a scrape target that's DOWN
description: call-metrics is Running 1/1, kubectl top works, and its /metrics endpoint serves fine on port 80 — but its dashboards are flat. The prometheus.io/port annotation points at 9090, where nothing listens, so the scrape is refused and the target is DOWN. Point the scrape port at the port /metrics is actually served on.
